name: io.github.quantisnow/sec-edgar-mcp
title: Quantisnow SEC EDGAR
description: SEC EDGAR full-text search, Form 4 insider trades, 13F holdings, 8-K events, XBRL financials.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: The searchable fields of one dataset, with what each holds. Free, doesn't count as a call.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run one query against a dataset and get JSON records with stable ids, newest first unless sort says otherwise. Datasets: filings (every EDGAR form), 8-k/events, insider-trades, ownership (13D/13G), 13f/holdings, financials (XBRL), congress/trades. Link records with their url field (the Quantisnow page), not linkToFilingIndex.

query.description: Lucene-style query, e.g. issuer.ticker:NVDA AND transactionCodes:P

tools.name: full_text_search
tools.description: Find SEC filings (and, with kinds, FDA approvals) by the words inside them, exhibits included, ranked by relevance. Returns each filing's form, filer, time, its Quantisnow page as url (link this one when citing), the EDGAR index and up to three matching passages. Use quotes for phrases and combine with fields: text (The filing's own words, exhibits included. Bare words and "quoted phrases" search here.) formType (Form as EDGAR names it, any case: 10-K, 8-K, "SC 13D", 4.) filedAt (Acceptance time. Ranges like filedAt:[2026-01-01 TO 2026-06-30] or filedAt:>=2026-10-01.) ticker (Any ticker the filing is about.) cik (Filer CIK, zero-padded to 10 digits.) companyName (Filer name; words match, not only the full name.) items (8-K item numbers, e.g. items:"2.02".) description (Our one-line description of the filing.) accessionNo (EDGAR accession number.) Example: "going concern" AND formType:10-K AND filedAt:>=2026-01-01 Words outside quotes only need to appear somewhere in the same filing, so when a subject and an action must be in the same passage, write "words near each other"~N (all words within N positions, any order) and OR several of them for verb variants: ("chief executive resigned"~10 OR "chief executive retirement"~10). * and OR do not work inside quotes. The response's coverage {from, to} is the window of filings searched; nothing outside it can match.

facets.description: Also count matches by form type, month and company.

kinds.description: What to search: filing (SEC filings, the default), fda (FDA approvals and newsroom), explainer (Quantisnow insider-buy write-ups).
